easyPrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting a creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
